title: 路面凍結防止砂の貯蔵箱
description: 坂道や歩道脇で散布用の砂・融雪材を保管する閉蓋状態の箱。テーパー付き中空本体、補強リブ、斜め蓋、蝶番、取っ手と接地スキッドを備えます。砂・散布器具は付属しません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.250 × 0.857 × 0.828 m、4,172三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A closed-lid storage bin for grit or de-icing material beside sloping streets and sidewalks. Includes a tapered hollow body, reinforcement ribs, weather-shedding lid, hinges, handles and ground skids. Loose grit and spreading tools are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.250 × 0.857 × 0.828 m; 4,172 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
